footer.description: A platform that helps users and handymen connect in Montenegro — request a handyman free of charge.

hero.headline: Need a handyman?
hero.subline: Find the help you need without calling place after place.
hero.handymanSubline: Browse open requests in your categories and send an offer.

howUsers.title: How it works for users
howUsers.subtitle: One short request — handymen who match your listing respond through the platform.

steps.title: Request a handyman for free
steps.description: Add a short description, city, and photos if needed. Posting is free.

steps.title: Handymen see the request
steps.description: After review, the request is visible to handymen who match the city and job type.

steps.title: Make an agreement
steps.description: Continue the conversation with the handyman in the way that suits you.

howUsers.note: One request instead of many separate calls.

howHandymen.title: For handymen
howHandymen.subtitle: No subscription. You receive starter credits and pay only when you unlock a client contact.

steps.title: Jobs come to you
steps.description: You get notified when a request matches your trade and city.

steps.title: Free registration + starter credits
steps.description: Registration is free. You get starter credits and begin without a subscription.

steps.title: Pay only when you want the contact
steps.description: Credits are used only when you decide to unlock the client contact.

howHandymen.creditNote: Credits are not a subscription. They are spent only when you unlock a contact for a job you want.

create.metadataDescription: Send a request and find a handyman in Montenegro.

handymanDashboard.systemIntro: Clients publish requests — you see them in the list. Viewing the description, city, category, and photos is free.
handymanDashboard.phoneHidden: You do not see the phone number immediately: you get it only after confirming that you want the contact for that job.
handymanDashboard.creditsExplanation: Credits are used to unlock contact details. They are spent only at that moment. After unlocking, you can send an offer or call the client.
handymanDashboard.refundPolicy: Credit refunds apply if admin marks spam or bypass attempts, or for a technical error — not if the user does not respond.
